title.en: Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Akujo Reijou desu ga, Konyakusha no Amai Oshioki ni Kanaimasen
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Dareka Kono Joukyou wo Setsumei Shite Kudasai!
Konyaku Hakisareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nariagari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita
Kon'yakusha no Uwaki Genba o Michatta no de Hajimari no Kane ga Narimashita
Megane Koushaku no Hatsukoi to Jimi Reijou no Kusare Kansatsu Nikki
Munou Saijo wa Akujo ni Naritai ~Gimai no Migawari de Totsuida Reijou, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai~
Konyaku Haki no Akui wa Shoukan Kara Okaeshi Shimasu
Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
